_comment: Los Angeles x Plumber — the first real market-vertical.
SUBMARKET GEOMETRY IS STILL EDITABLE. Nothing has been scanned, so these centroids can be
moved freely until Phase 2 runs its first geogrid. After that they are frozen: changing a
centre invalidates every snapshot taken against it and resets delta history. Review them now.
Coverage: 14 submarkets at a 5-mile radius cover the LA basin — the city plus the inner
metro (San Fernando Valley, San Gabriel Valley, South Bay, Long Beach). This is NOT all of
LA County, which is 4,751 sq mi and would need far more. It is the area a local SEO client
would plausibly serve. Add submarkets rather than widening radii if that is too narrow.
Names are functional, not labels: each goes into the Outscraper query text as
'plumber, <name>', so they must be place names Google recognises.
